g.text: Hit a refusal? The category picks the path
Read stop_details.category, then follow the row. Re-sending the same turn to the same model usually refuses again.
the organisation applies to Anthropic with its use case
if approved, safeguards are adjusted for that organisation
re-test first: Fable 5.1 lets medical and textbook questions through
weapons uplift is a hard line in the Usage Policy
still blocked? report the false positive to Anthropic
benign ML work · prompts that ask
for reasoning in the output text
instead of a <thinking> section in the answer
still blocked? Anthropic support + request ID
Fallback on Bedrock: build it client-side
Server-side fallbacks ("default") are Claude API only. On Bedrock, use the Anthropic SDK refusal-fallback middleware or retry on another model yourself.
Some categories have a recommended fallback model; others don't, and the refusal stands. Reset the conversation before you retry.
Mythos 5.1 (same model as Fable 5.1, looser safeguards) is trusted access that Anthropic grants directly. AWS can't add customers.
Check which models and platforms CVP and LSVP cover on Anthropic's pages before you promise a customer a path.
